title: The architecture decisions at a glance

cards.title: One record per decision
cards.text: Each ADR holds its context, the decision as a rule, and what it costs; one set of numbers for the whole repo.

cards.title: The provider is configuration
cards.text: Our own loop behind IChatClient, and a strategy per provider (0002, 0003).

cards.title: A session stays as it started
cards.text: Toolsets per session and an append-only history (0006, 0008).

cards.title: Measured and guarded
cards.text: Every request on the ledger, arguments as data, the context guarded (0007, 0004, 0005).

cards.title: The framework holds no agent
cards.text: Engine, identities and packs; the folders say what ships; core ships no agent (0027, 0074, 0076).
